wins.text: Gross margins expanded 150 bps to 44.8%, driven by strategic pricing, lower ocean freight rates and supply chain efficiency; ex-restructuring EPS of $0.98, up 24% YoY
North America Q3 revenue grew 3%, with EBIT up 18% on a reported basis, exceeding internal expectations with lighter markdowns than competitors
Performance footwear grew high single digits with double-digit growth in $100+ franchises including Kobe, Ja, Metcon, Motiva, Structure and Vomero; basketball returned to strong double-digit growth
Won German Football Federation kit contract starting 2027, beating out competitors in a competitive pitch
New and updated footwear models now represent a majority of top 20 growing footwear franchises; new products on track to generate a multibillion-dollar annual run rate

risks.text: Q4 revenue guided to 'up slightly' with H1 FY25 revenue expected to be down low single digits due to franchise lifecycle management headwinds outpacing new product scaling
EMEA Q3 revenue declined 4%, falling short of internal expectations amid increased macro volatility and softening consumer demand; NIKE Digital EMEA down 10%
NIKE Digital down 4% globally in Q3 with further near-term headwinds expected as franchise lifecycle management disproportionately impacts the digital channel
Approximately $403M in restructuring charges incurred in Q3 ($450M total expected in H2), impacting reported EPS and SG&A; reported diluted EPS of $0.77 vs. $0.98 ex-charges

Higher markdowns, worsening FX headwinds (1 point negative impact on Q4 reported revenue), and reduced channel mix benefits from franchise lifecycle management partially offsetting gross margin expansion

guidance_items.detail: Full year FY24 revenue still expected to grow approximately 1%; Q4 revenue now guided to 'up slightly' vs. prior expectation, reflecting shipment timing benefits pulled into Q3 and lower digital growth
Q4 gross margins expected to expand ~160-180 bps; full year gross margin expansion now ~120 bps including ~60 bps FX headwind
Full year earnings outlook reaffirmed excluding restructuring charges; full year SG&A now expected to grow low single digits including charges, improving vs. prior guidance

H1 FY25 revenue expected to be down low single digits due to franchise lifecycle management headwinds; full FY25 revenue and earnings expected to grow vs. FY24 with operating margin expansion ex-restructuring

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Difficulty or friction in rebuilding wholesale distribution muscle and partner relationships after years of DTC-first strategy
Specific channel and geography breakdown for H1 FY25 revenue guidance (down low single digits)
Progress and investment in run specialty (RSG) channel as a brand authentication vehicle
